description: A beautiful reader for Orion with a built-in Wall Breaker (anti-adblock walls, dialogs and forced redirects are broken automatically): a draggable Reader pill appears on article pages and opens a calm, themed reader view with great typography. Toolbar popup for global settings and the always-use-Reader site list. Per-site auto-open, multi-page stitching, resume, contents, highlights with notes and Markdown export, per-site typography, and a save-for-later library.
name: Beautiful Reader for Orion
